Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.surveyaction.surveyparquet

Class ParquetFileMeasurement

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.surveyaction.surveyparquet.ParquetFileMeasurement
public class ParquetFileMeasurement extends Object
ParquetFileMeasurement captures the measurements taken from the footer of a Parquet file, so that they can be stored as JSON in the measurement annotation. The properties match the names in ParquetFileMetric.
